page.title: Best Hummingbird Feeder with Camera (2026): Ant Moat, Battery and No-Subscription Picks
page.desc: Birdfy Hum Feeder vs Bird Buddy Pro vs FeatherSnap: which camera hummingbird feeder keeps ants out, holds a charge and skips the monthly fee. Specs and prices verified 2026-11-06.
page.intro:
Short answer. The best hummingbird feeder with camera is the Birdfy Hum Feeder ({buy:birdfy-hum-feeder}): a built-in ant moat, a 14 fl oz nectar tank, a 9,000 mAh battery, 1080p video and free hummingbird ID with 30 days of cloud clips. Ants are the most common complaint with camera feeders, and the Bird Buddy Smart Hummingbird Feeder Pro has no ant moat, so you must add one. If you want the sharpest pictures, Bird Buddy's Pro wins: 5 MP stills and 2K HDR video, but it costs about twice as much and automatic bird ID needs its Premium plan at 8.25 dollars a month after the first free month. For a busy feeder, the Birdfy Hum Feeder Duo ({buy:birdfy-hum-feeder-duo}) adds a second 2K camera and a 20 fl oz tank.

Every feeder here records only when a bird trips the motion sensor, uploads over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, and needs a nectar change every 2 to 3 days in summer heat. Buy the solar panel if your feeder gets more than a few dozen visits a day: one tester with about 200 visits a day was charging the Birdfy every 3 days without it.
page.after:
What owners complain about

Across reviews and store Q&A, five issues come up again and again. Ants reaching the nectar is the first; Bird Buddy's own FAQ tells you to buy a water moat separately. Empty or missed clips is second: Birdfy feeders have no motion sensitivity setting, so a feeder swinging in wind can log dozens of blank clips, while Bird Buddy goes the other way with a 10-minute cooldown after each session and skips many visits at a busy feeder. Battery drain without solar is third, with a weekly charge typical for Bird Buddy in shade and every 3 days for a very busy Birdfy. Fourth is Wi-Fi: all three need a 2.4 GHz network and a decent signal at the feeder. Fifth is the lid: a few Birdfy owners report the base leaking if it is not seated squarely after a refill.

Which one by need

  • First camera feeder, ants or fees are the worry: Birdfy Hum Feeder. Ant moat built in, free ID, 30 days of cloud clips, 2-year warranty.
  • Best pictures to share: Bird Buddy Smart Hummingbird Feeder Pro. 5 MP stills and 2K HDR video beat Birdfy's 1080p. Budget for an ant moat and, for automatic ID, the Premium plan.
  • Busy feeder, two angles: Birdfy Hum Feeder Duo. Two 2K cameras, 120 fps slow motion and a 20 fl oz tank.
  • Fewest refills: FeatherSnap Smart Hummingbird Feeder. The 1 L tank is more than double the others and the ant moat and solar panel are included, but full app features sit behind a monthly plan.

Not recommended

Generic 'AI hummingbird feeder' listings sold under rotating brand names on marketplaces. They copy the Birdfy design but reviews report feeders that stop uploading after a month, and there is no US support line or stated warranty. Also skip any camera feeder without an ant moat or a plan to add one; the nectar will be covered within days.
